createOrReplace.title: Application Requirements | American University of Sharjah
createOrReplace.excerpt: Applicants must have an average equivalent to 85% or higher ... in each of the last three years of secondary education ... personal statement and two recommendation letters ... the average minimum requirement of 85% serves as a guideline ... may be higher. Mandatory subjects (Minimum Grade B): Engineering majors Math and Physics (physics completed by at least Grade 11); Business majors Math; Science majors (including Computer Science) Math and a Science subject. American Curriculum: minimum of 85% average in each of the last three years ... SAT Math score of 450 and above ... SAT Math is mandatory. British Curriculum: complete Year 13 ... five IGCSE/GCSE (O-Level) subjects with a minimum grade of 5 or B in each subject, and either three AS-Level subjects, or two A-level subjects with a minimum grade of B in each subject. IB: full IB Diploma with six subjects (excluding Islamic Education), at least three at Higher Level, minimum score of 24 points ... a guideline ... may be higher. General Secondary Curriculum (Thanaweya Ammah and Applied Technology): minimum of 85% average in each of the last three years. English: IELTS Academic 6.5, TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80), TOEFL ITP 550.

createOrReplace.title: Tuition and Fees | American University of Sharjah
createOrReplace.excerpt: UNDERGRADUATE TUITION AND FEES FOR ACADEMIC YEAR 2026-2027: Tuition for all majors is AED 110,876 per academic year (AED 55,438 per semester, 12 to 16 credits). Student Activities Fee AED 422 + 5% VAT per semester. Lab/Technology Fee Type A AED 1,552 per course; Type B AED 1,700 per course. Residential Halls Fees Academic Year 2025-2026: Shared room (double occupancy with a shared bath and kitchenette) 7,000 per regular semester; Utilities Service Fee 290; 5% VAT charge applies. Updated: 16/03/2026.

set.academic_threshold: British curriculum: Year 13 completed, with five IGCSE/GCSE subjects at grade 5/B or above and either three AS-Levels or two A-Levels at grade B or above. Maths at grade B or above (completed in your last three years). Plus a personal statement and two school recommendation letters. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80) / ITP 550. The 85% is a guideline; admission is competitive and the real cut-off can be higher.

Full IB Diploma with six subjects (excluding Islamic Education), at least three at Higher Level, and at least 24 points (a guideline; it can be higher). Maths at grade B or above (completed in your last three years). Plus a personal statement and two school recommendation letters. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80) / ITP 550. The 85% is a guideline; admission is competitive and the real cut-off can be higher.

American curriculum: at least 85% average in each of your last three years, and SAT Math 450 or above (mandatory). Maths at grade B or above (completed in your last three years). Plus a personal statement and two school recommendation letters. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80) / ITP 550. The 85% is a guideline; admission is competitive and the real cut-off can be higher.

UAE General Secondary (Thanaweya Ammah) certificate: at least 85% average in each of your last three years. Maths at grade B or above (completed in your last three years). Plus a personal statement and two school recommendation letters. English: IELTS Academic 6.5 or TOEFL iBT 4.5 (previously 80) / ITP 550. The 85% is a guideline; admission is competitive and the real cut-off can be higher.
